description: Permissions for the main window. Deny-by-default: grant each permission only when a feature needs it, and document why. allow-get-app-info: version and schema on screen. allow-get-workspace-state, allow-enter-workspace, allow-exit-workspace: the fullscreen workspace and its exit control. core:event:allow-listen, core:event:allow-unlisten: receive workspace://changed when the workspace is left by the emergency shortcut or the system fullscreen control. The global-shortcut plugin is used from Rust only; none of its permissions are granted.
